title: Resources
metaDescription: Videos, lecture notes, presentations, and infographics for the Global Reasoning Challenge.
body:
Home / Resources
Materials

Resources

Videos, lecture notes, presentations, and infographics to help students, teachers, and ambassadors get the most out of GRC.

Vi

Videos

Short explainer videos walking through past problems and general reasoning strategy, useful for self-study or classroom viewing.

Ln

Lecture Notes

Written notes covering each of the six domains at an introductory level, suitable for a single class period or independent reading.

Pr

Presentations

Ready-to-use slide decks for introducing GRC at your school, at an ambassador event, or in a classroom setting.

In

Infographics

One-page visual summaries of the competition timeline, the six domains, and past results, formatted for print or social sharing.

Materials 2026

Posters & downloads

Printable materials to introduce the competition at your school.

Fl

Flyer

The competition at a glance, on one page.

Tt

Timetable

All rounds, dates, and deadlines.

Vm

Vision & Mission

The idea and goals behind the competition.

Ps

Presentation

Slides to introduce the competition at your school.

Aa

Ambassador Activities

Event and outreach ideas for local ambassadors.

Pz

Prizes & Awards

Honours, certificates, and prize money.
